series.name: CPI Shelter
series.source_caveat: Observations are stamped with the REFERENCE month, not the release date. July data carries 2026-07-01 but does not publish until mid-August, so a current print always looks 40 to 60 days old here. Prior months get revised, sometimes heavily.
